en: Duran - A messenger has arrived from Cutis. The Cutis resistance under General Arcia has risen in a great revolt and is fighting the Imperial army everywhere. General Arcia seems to be asking Dagal to send reinforcements.
Iyolin - Arcia... wasn't he the man who led the royal guard of the old Kingdom of Cutis?
Draupnir - Lately he has been leading what's left of the Cutis army in a guerrilla war from the mountains, but he is in no position to face the Imperial army yet...

Duran - They say an Imperial general was assassinated near Nohot, a city in northern Cutis. When the Empire used that as a pretext for outrageous demands, the people of Nohot rose in a great riot, and the resistance could not stand by and watch them be massacred. Now they are fighting over the Imperial fortress near Nohot, and it seems things are not going too badly.
Draupnir - They may hold for now, but once the Imperial troops in Pandragon are sent in, the forces of Cutis will be no match for them.
Iyolin - It seems we must step in and help them. I will lead the knights to Cutis.

Draupnir - No. It is a battle we cannot win. If you or the knights suffer losses in a fight like this, our war against the Empire will only grow harder, and the soldiers' morale will suffer. It would be better for Prince Rashid to lead the mercenaries to Cutis.
Draupnir - Yes, you. In the battles to come, the prince may have to lead from the front anyway. It would be good for your future to gain experience now.
Iyolin - But isn't it dangerous for Rashid to go alone? Especially in a battle we cannot win...

Draupnir - Hmm... That is why I mean to send GS with him. GS is thorough in everything he does; he should be able to protect the prince. And the aim of this campaign is not to defeat the Imperial army in Cutis, but to protect the Cutis resistance and bring them to Dagal.
Iyolin - Bring them back to Dagal?

Draupnir - Yes. Even with our troops there, if the Imperial magic armor marches north from Pandragon into Cutis, we could not win with many times our numbers. It is wiser to preserve their strength now and wait for another day.
GS - Then wouldn't we have a chance if we used magic armor too?

Draupnir - No. What matters is Astania and Pandragon, not Cutis. That is exactly why I oppose sending Her Highness and the Holy Knights: we must be ready for an Imperial invasion of Astania. Besides, we have so little magic armor that we cannot split it between two fronts, and if we lost any in battle, our situation would become desperate. The magic armor and the Holy Knights must be kept at full strength for the coming battles in Astania and Pandragon.
Rashid - But I... I'm not good with a sword... and I've never gone to battle without my sister...
Draupnir - That is exactly why you need experience. One day you will return as king of a restored Pandragon.
Iyolin - I agree with Lord Draupnir. Rashid! I can't look after you forever. This may be a good chance for you. GS, please take care of Rashid. I'm sure you can keep him safe.
GS - I'll do my best... Whatever happens, I'll make sure the prince comes to no harm.
